arguments.text: 8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Goal: settle after the hard start to about critical power (boat ~122 W, shaft ~189 W, to be checked by heart rate: HR should level off at CP), spend reserve evenly, keep ~30-40 % reserve for the last 1000-1500 m, then finish sprint around 600-800 m to go. Watch for incidents (weed on rudder = speed drop at same pod power; pod drift = pod power vs boat power/HR disagree; radio course change). Use pieces/measure only if they pay.
Good start. Settle now into your race rhythm.

8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back (odd legs out, with current ~+0.07 m/s; even legs back, against). Blew up at ~740 s; CP pod belief 195 W (189-200), reserve small. Pace per leg with hold + pace target: out legs ~154-155 s/500 GPS (~193 W), back legs ~159-160 (~200 W). Re-cue pace after each turn (cue budget ~1 per leg). Do NOT let them run above ~205 W before the last 1000 m. Finish: build from ~800 m to go, ask finish at ~400-500 m to go if pod reserve allows. Weed: suspected and cleared at 567 s; watch speed_loss; clear_rudder if a step loss at steady pod power.
